title: S3.7c SAB 21800 malformed face-loop next-link refusal fast test

scope.contract: Malformed pointer rows in the rooted/traversed graph fail transactionally with exact source-node and pointer-ordinal diagnostics; they are not ordinary projected coverage gaps.
scope.wrong_type_case: A parser-fed loop.next pointer to a point builds a model, then rooted projection refuses with InvalidReference at the source loop, ordinal 1, and clears output.
scope.truncated_row_case: A resolved pointer row shortened after model construction while its source tokens remain intact refuses with InvalidReference at the loop's missing ordinal 1 and clears output.
distinctions: A well-formed null loop.next pointer remains a classified chain terminator.
A cycle of valid loop references remains an observed topology gap rather than a malformed pointer-type error.
